name: Retsujou Kanki ~Nikubou to Nakadashi o Motomeru Onna-tachi~
original_name: 劣情喚起 ～肉棒と中出しを求めるオンナ達～
source:
"Whoa. What am I thinking? She's part of my team..."

Lust shut down my mind. My libido went from simmering to a strong boil.

I'm seeing my party members as women. Soft, supple women...
Could this be my inner power getting out of control? My power of "evocation", not just boosting our bonds but our sexual attraction to each other? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE151320.html]DLsite English[/url]]
